meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Resend 邮件发送通道到聊天应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天应用中添加邮件发送能力
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Resend email channel into your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add email sending to a chat application

howto.what: 让 NanoClaw 通过 Resend 收发邮件:自动复制注册邮件适配器、安装依赖、构建验证,并引导填写 Resend 账户、域名、API 密钥、webhook 等凭据,最终把用户邮箱设为拥有者并发测试邮件。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 Resend 邮件、给 NanoClaw 加邮件通道,或要求配置邮件收发时触发。

say.text: 帮我接入 Resend 邮件,让我能用邮箱和 NanoClaw 对话。
say.note: 将执行添加适配器、配置凭据等步骤。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加 Resend 邮件通道。
配置 Resend 邮件集成,然后给我发一封测试邮件。
say.note: 会引导填写凭据并发送 hello 邮件。

howto.what_en: Enables NanoClaw to send and receive email via Resend: copies and registers the email adapter, installs the dependency, runs validation, then guides you through providing Resend account, domain, API key, and webhook details, sets your email as owner, and sends a test email.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Resend email integration, enable email channel for NanoClaw, or configure email sending/receiving.

say_en.text: Set up Resend email so I can talk to NanoClaw via email.
say_en.note: Runs adapter copy, registration, and credential setup.

say_en.text: Add Resend email channel to NanoClaw.
Configure Resend email integration and send me a test email.
say_en.note: Guides credential entry and sends hello email.
